name: Light Sensitivity
body:
You have difficulty seeing in bright conditions.

Prerequisite: Darkvision

Effect: You become dazzled in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. A dazzled creature takes a -1 on all attack rolls and Search and Spot checks.
